refutes.statement: Reduction (b): at a fixed key, rerun Theorem Z's argument with the constraint t = 0 first; every maximum of (-t, r', Lambda') has a free-valid owner (Lemma P's threat-injectivity survives). Refuted at the key (10, 1): a maximum of (-t, r', Lambda') has no free-valid owner.

witness.mechanism (verbatim): Agent 2 (top 10 = g) holds its top 9 of U_2 with x's good 1 as a filler. Its lower goods 3, 6 (3 + 2 > 4) are in the pool, so every owner threatens it. Swapping 1 for 3 would put 1 into the pool next to x's good 5, and 4 + 5 > 8 gives t = 1.
